name: constellation
description: Constellation Harness — a multi-agent software delivery workflow for Claude Code, plus optional stack skill packs.

plugins.name: constellation
plugins.description: Core harness: orchestrator, 11 persona agents, MLP product discovery, test-verified engineering workflow, quality gates, workflow commands, state and metrics.

plugins.name: constellation-stack-node
plugins.description: Stack skill pack: TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL (+ Apollo Federation 2), Prisma, observability, error handling, security checklist, schema compatibility.

plugins.name: constellation-stack-frontend
plugins.description: Stack skill pack: distinctive, production-grade frontend design guidance (typography, color, motion, composition).

plugins.name: constellation-stack-service
plugins.description: Boilerplate skill pack for constellation-service–derived backends: add-domain-entity playbook, e2e test harness, Terraform/ECS deployment. Layers on top of constellation-stack-node.

plugins.name: constellation-stack-infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure pack: Cloud Architect agent (AWS + OCI) designing cloud solutions as reusable Terraform module building blocks, with skills for module design, multi-environment state, the OCI Always Free container platform, and accessory services (secrets, certificates, DNS).
